Third-party engines bundled in vendor/
======================================

This site bundles WebAssembly builds of three reverse-engineering engines:

1. Keystone.js  — port of the Keystone assembler framework
   - npm: @alexaltea/keystone-js
   - upstream: https://github.com/keystone-engine/keystone
   - license: GPLv2 (see https://github.com/keystone-engine/keystone/blob/master/LICENSE)
   - files: keystone.js, keystone.wasm

2. Capstone.js  — port of the Capstone disassembler framework
   - npm: @alexaltea/capstone-js
   - upstream: https://github.com/capstone-engine/capstone
   - license: BSD 3-Clause (see https://github.com/capstone-engine/capstone/blob/master/LICENSES.TXT)
   - files: capstone.js, capstone.wasm

3. Unicorn.js   — port of the Unicorn CPU emulator framework
   - npm: @alexaltea/unicorn-js
   - upstream: https://github.com/unicorn-engine/unicorn
   - license: GPLv2 (see https://github.com/unicorn-engine/unicorn/blob/master/COPYING)
   - files: unicorn_x86.js, unicorn_arm.js, unicorn_aarch64.js,
            unicorn_mips.js, unicorn_ppc.js, unicorn_sparc.js
     (each file embeds its architecture-specific WebAssembly module)

All builds are powered by Emscripten (https://emscripten.org).
Keystone and Unicorn are GPLv2-licensed; this page links to their sources
above as required. Capstone is BSD-3-Clause.
